The implement features multiple curved metal moldboards (shares) at the front, supported by a frame with two large spoked wheels and a smaller depth-control wheel. A long hitch arm extends to the right for attachment to a tractor. The background shows rolling hills with patches of green grass and brown earth under a blue sky.
